latestVersion.changelog:
video-meta 1.0.0 — initial release

- Instantly generate titles, tags, and descriptions for videos via simple prompts or file uploads.
- Supports MP4, MOV, AVI, and WebM files up to 500MB.
- Automatic cloud connection and session management with 100 free credits for new users.
- Exports processed videos in high-quality MP4 by default, ready for download in 20–40 seconds.
- Designed for YouTubers, content creators, and marketers needing fast, accurate video metadata generation.
